This mind-mapping is portrayed in the BBC s modern TV series adaptation of the Sherlock Holmes books called,  Sherlock . In a climactic episode there is a scene with a very vivid portrayal of Sherlock s mind map. This is a fascinating scene, but is in a season finale so is full of spoilers.
